# exile v0.14.0 - Table of Contents

NIF based solution to interact with external programs with back-pressure

## Pages

- [Exile](https://exile.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://exile.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Exile](https://exile.hexdocs.pm/Exile.md): Exile is an alternative for beam [ports](https://hexdocs.pm/elixir/Port.html)
with back-pressure and non-blocking IO.
- [Exile.Process](https://exile.hexdocs.pm/Exile.Process.md): GenServer which wraps spawned external command.
- [Exile.Stream](https://exile.hexdocs.pm/Exile.Stream.md): Defines a `Exile.Stream` struct returned by `Exile.stream!/2`.

- Exceptions
  - [Exile.Process.Error](https://exile.hexdocs.pm/Exile.Process.Error.md)
  - [Exile.Stream.AbnormalExit](https://exile.hexdocs.pm/Exile.Stream.AbnormalExit.md)
